'''Nyn Kablo''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] militant who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Her group was formed to protect the interests of the common Twi'leks on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and came into conflict with a group of thugs led by [[Angu Drombb]] that were terrorizing the nearby mine of [[New Meen]]. Her group was headquartered in the town of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nyn Kablo was designed by [[Dave Allen]] and [[Daniel Lovat Clark]] for ''[[The Long Arm of the Hutt]]'', a supplement ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2012]].
